name: WOMEN ART OPEN Berlin
description: The second edition of WOMEN ART OPEN transforms Berlin into a citywide platform promoting visibility for female artists, past and present. Following the successful 2025 launch, the initiative has grown significantly, uniting museums, municipal galleries, art associations, and project spaces. Through exhibitions, performances, discussions, and interdisciplinary events, the program sends a powerful message in support of women in the arts. Multiple venues participate across Berlin, creating a networked cultural movement that challenges historical erasure and contemporary underrepresentation.
